name: Breadcrumbs
short_desc: Private location timeline and KlimaTicket ride counter: the phone's stays, moves and rides, kept at home.
author: Florian Geymayer
description: Server for the Breadcrumbs app: the phone's location timeline (stays, moves, places, GPS fixes) and its counted KlimaTicket rides, synced to the homelab and searchable. There is no web interface yet: expose the app on a domain reachable at home and over the VPN only, then pair the phone with the code from the app's log. Dev image: follows the newest dev build until the first release.

form_fields.label: Public address
form_fields.hint: The https:// address the phone uses (the domain you expose this app on). With it the pairing code in the log also comes as a QR code to scan in the app. Optional.

form_fields.label: Backup passphrase
form_fields.hint: Encrypts the server's backups (AES-256-GCM). Keep it in the password manager too: without it a backup cannot be restored. Empty: plain backups.

form_fields.label: Keep detailed GPS for (days)
form_fields.hint: Detailed trip fixes older than this are thinned to one per minute; stays, moves, places and rides are kept. 0 keeps everything. Default 365.
